narrative.intro: Noridian Healthcare Solutions recorded $329M in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. The company won 7 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $47M, and obligations were up 39.2% year over year. Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers is the dominant market by NAICS with $292M in obligations, followed by All Other Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services with $36.9M. Computer Systems Design Services shows $0 in obligations for the current fiscal year to date. Fiscal-year obligations have varied over time: FY21: $324M, FY22: $291M, FY23: $154M, FY24: $252M, FY25: $236M, FY26: $329M. The note for this record states that figures are contract obligations except where award-value figures are explicitly labeled as total contract values, and that current-year totals are partial because they cover the fiscal year to date. Contractors and agencies looking at Noridian should treat FY2026 to date totals as incomplete and use the NAICS breakdown to see where the current obligations are concentrated.

sections.heading: How have Noridian Healthcare Solutions obligations changed over recent years?
